laws.rule: Anyone outside the settlements must carry polar bear deterrents; the Governor recommends a firearm. Loaded firearms are banned in Longyearbyen and firearms are not allowed in shops or public buildings.
laws.heading: Polar bear protection

laws.rule: Keep at least 300 m from polar bears (500 m from 1 March to 30 June) and retreat if one comes close. Keep 150 m from walrus haul-outs, with a 5-knot limit within 300 m.
laws.heading: Wildlife distances

laws.rule: No drones within 500 m of bird cliffs from 1 April to 31 August, and none in protected areas.
laws.heading: Drones

laws.rule: All camping as part of tourism needs a permit applied for four weeks ahead. Landings on Nordaustlandet and Edgeøya need notice four weeks ahead.
laws.heading: Camping and landings

laws.rule: All cultural monuments from before 1946 are automatically protected, with a 100 m safety zone around each.
laws.heading: Cultural heritage
